verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents the core agent purchase loop. The buyer agent creates a delegated `pay` or `kya-pay` token committed against its wallet, including through MCP tools such as create-pay-token. The seller charges that token after delivery, and Skyfire moves the funds, with guaranteed settlement up to the committed amount. Card-based agentic checkout is also documented via the Payments React SDK, with cardholder-approved spending ceilings, buy-now and buy-later purchases, and kya-pay guest checkout. Missing for 10: an explicit checkout-session object or flow is only implied, a documented order-confirmation step or artifact beyond the charge and settlement is absent, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed purchase (the runtime probe only confirms the key-gated token API is live).
